text:
liam: Heads-up — seeing p95/p99 latency spikes for hosted inference after idle GPU node downscales in eu-west1. Cold-start token generation time ~4x for some requests.
sara: I pulled the event logs — CA removed several nodes within a 6m window, pods got rescheduled onto spot-backed instances and we hit preemptions. Backfills queued behind long warmup.
james: Can you paste the autoscaler/scale-down config and recent events? want to see thresholds.
sara: snippet from events: `Normal  ScaleDown  cluster-autoscaler  Scale down: node group gpud-spot-eu-west1-3 size 8 -> 2 (maxUnavailable=2)` then a series of `Evicted` + `Preempted` messages. also saw repeated driver re-init logs.
priya: This is classic hysteresis + eviction ordering problem. Two quick levers: 1) add a soft-evict annotation for nodes that have warmed kv-cache so CA prefers not to drain them, 2) increase scaleDownUnneededTime/Delay so we avoid chopping the pool during short lulls.
james: Agreed. Also consider reserving a tiny standby pool (2 nodes) with a different TTL and taint so critical routes don't hit spot churn. cheaper than repeated cold inference.
liam: I want concrete config to try in staging eu-west1. Priya, can you propose numbers?
priya: Proposal for staging:
```
clusterAutoscaler:
  scaleDownUnneededTime: 20m
  scaleDownDelayAfterAdd: 12m
  scaleDownUnreadyTime: 25m
nodePool:
  standbyMinSize: 2  # small reserved buffer
  evictionGracePeriod: 12m
  softEvictAnnotation: "inference/cache-sticky"
```
also add process that tags nodes with `cache-sticky=true` when driver reports kv cache warmed for >3m. CA/admission hook will treat those as non-evictable for the hysteresis window.
jeames: Typo: j->james. (quick)
james: I'll own the staging deployment. Also propose queue-priority for high-qps routes so we can preempt low-priority requests into spot nodes.
eva: Note: ap-southeast has terrible spot availability right now — cross-region fallback will add egress cost. If we increase standby in eu-west1 we avoid regional fallback. cost tradeoff: standby nodes vs cross-region egress + latency to us-east.
liam: Good call. For experiment: staging eu-west1 for 24h with priya's config + standbyMinSize=2. Monitor p95/p99, token cost, and preemption rate. If preemptions drop >70% and p99 improves, we roll to prod for critical routes.
devops-bot: ALERT: scale-to-zero-latency-signal exceeded threshold in eu-west1 at 2026-03-18T10:02:00Z — routed to #eng-oncall.
sara: I'll attach a short query to surface driver init times and KV cache hit-rate.
liam: Action items: james -> deploy config to staging by EOD; sara -> dashboard panels for driver-init + cache-hit; priya -> small hook to tag warmed nodes; eva -> cost model delta for standby vs cross-region fallback.
priya: i'll sketch the tagging admission hook and a small probe (curl to health endpoint that returns cache-age). simple.
